source.title: 40 years generalized analytic functions recent trends and open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the single URL input as the zbMATH resolver record https://zbmath.org/1023238. Direct shell fetching of the zbMATH web record returned HTTP 403, but the zbMATH API endpoint identified the exact work as Wolfgang Tutschke, '40 years generalized analytic functions recent trends and open problems', Zbl 0887.30029, in Continuum mechanics and related problems of analysis, pages 444-465, 1993.

failure_mode=metadata_only. The zbMATH API record supplied bibliographic identity metadata and a reviewer summary, but exposed no DOI, arXiv identifier, external full-text URL, or direct PDF link. The resolver metadata was not used as a technical source for extraction.

failure_mode=metadata_only / ambiguous_resolution. Bounded exact-work recovery searched the exact title, exact title plus PDF/filetype:pdf, the author-title pair, and the proceedings title plus page range. Inspected candidates included a Nonlinear Analysis PDF and CiteSeerX mirror that only cite the exact work in their references, and Studylib/Scribd copies of 'Real and Complex Fundamental Solutions - A Way for Unifying Mathematical Analysis', a different 2002 mini-course by the same author. No candidate provided readable full text for the same 1993 article.
No document map was created because no readable exact-work PDF or HTML full-text artifact was recovered.

Source adequacy gate failed: extracting questions from resolver metadata, bibliographic references, search snippets, or a different Tutschke paper would violate the source-adequacy and no-new-facts rules.
